name: Shri Gulam Ali

social_activities: A distinguished member of the Scheduled Tribe (Gurjar/Gujjar) community; excelled in social life with political orientation for the past three decades; was a socio-political activist; was active in various capacities of senior leadership for almost a decade JJSF(Jammu Joint Students’ Federation), a premier student organisation; was instrumental in a number of agitations in Jammu, including MBBS/BDS agitation in 1998; established, Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University and SK Agriculture University, Jammu, Jammu College of Engineering Technology (now GCET, Jammu); was in the forefront in organizing people and in spreading awareness highlighting the issues of the state of Jammu and Kashmir in areas like constitution of Delimitation Commission, equal employment opportunities of the downtrodden, marginalized and neglected sections of the society including SCs, STs and OBCs, etc for their due and appropriate representations; travelled across Jammu and Kashmir and other parts of India enlightening, inspiring and creating awareness among people about their rights; organized, (i) Jammu Chetna Yatra in 2001 and (ii) Janjagran Yatra in 2003, etc.
other_information: Was Provincial President, Political Secretary to Chairman, State Youth President and General Secretary, Jammu and Kashmir National Panthers Party (J.K.N.P.P.); took active part in the historic Shri Amar Nath Andolan in 2008; as a Member of the Jammu and Kashmir Study Group, organised All India Muslim programme at Jammu and distributed 5 lakh pamphlets creating awareness about the need for abrogation of Article 370; mobilised about 10 thousand of tribal/ minority people at the historic "Lalkar Rally" on December, 2013 at MAM stadium; worked as National Convener, Muslim Rashtriya Manch; Prabhari, Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh and Punjab; led nationalist movement “Hum Hindustani Jammu Kashmir Hindustan ka"; addressed thousands of programmes across the country particularly in Muslim majority areas
